SELECT DISTINCT TABCOUNTRY.CRY_0 AS CountryCode, ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0 AS CountryName FROM EXPLOIT.TABCOUNTRY TABCOUNTRY LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA ON TABCOUNTRY.CRY_0 = ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(TABCOUNTRY.CRY_0) = UPPER(#{Country}) OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) LIKE UPPER('%' + #{Country} + '%') )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

-- Only for US (America) SELECT DISTINCT IIF (BPADDRESS.SAT_0 = '', 'OTHERS', BPADDRESS.SAT_0) AS StateCode, BPADDRESS.SAT_0 AS StateName FROM EXPLOIT.BPADDRESS BPADDRESS WHERE BPADDRESS.CRY_0 = 'US'
AND ( UPPER(BPADDRESS.SAT_0) = UPPER(#{UsState}) OR UPPER(BPADDRESS.SAT_0) LIKE UPPER('%' + #{UsState} + '%') )
